notStarted: This ticket has not started yet
inGraph: This ticket belongs to a plan: change it in the plan
notQueued: Ticket {id} is not in the queue
orchestratorNotHelper: The manager is not a helper: send it to a helper
noProject: No project was named: a project is a folder in the work folder
workKept: {refused}; ticket #{n} and its changes are kept, and it can be sent again
drafting: {name} is drafting it: start it once the draft comes back
pickHint: Once picked, give it when moving to To do: {command}, with --json status "todo" and assignee (the profile's id)
noAssignee: No helper has been picked yet
queued: {full}: queued, it starts as soon as there is room
queuedStuck: The queued "{title}" could not start: {why}; it could not go back to To do either, and stays in the queue
queuedBack: The queued "{title}" could not start and stays in To do: {why}
graphRetry: This ticket belongs to a plan and follows it: retry the step in the plan, or reopen the whole plan
neverStarted: This ticket has never started: just start it
stillOpen: This ticket is still open: moving it back to To do is another round
stillWorking: {name} is still on this ticket: tell it directly
senderGone: The profile it was sent to, {id}, is gone
cronNoIssue: The scheduled task "{name}" could not write its ticket: {why}
cronNoStart: The scheduled task "{name}" could not start: {why}
closedReopen: This ticket is closed: reopen it with a few words
handOverOnTodo: Handing over happens when moving to To do: move it there and say who takes over
stopFirst: #{n} is still in this round: stop it, and hand it over once it has stopped
roundNeedsWords: Another round needs a few words: what it should do this round
orchestratorAnswers: This ticket is the manager's: it closes once the manager answers
graphAcceptance: This ticket belongs to a plan and follows it: accept it in the plan
nothingToAccept: Nothing has been handed back yet, so there is nothing to accept
failNeedsFindings: Failing the acceptance needs what is wrong: write at least one point

does.toOrchestrator: {n} goes to the manager to answer
does.noRoom: No room now ({full}): it is queued in To do and starts as soon as there is room
does.unqueue: {n} leaves the queue, back to Backlog
does.takesOver: {taker} takes over and carries on on the same branch
does.orchestratorRound: {n} goes back to the manager for another answer: {said}
does.completeNone: {n} closes as done: nothing to merge
does.completeKept: {n} closes as done: the branch is kept, not merged ({commits} commits)
does.commitFirst: First commit {helper}'s {files} uncommitted files for it
does.check: Run the project's check before merging (.vibevalley/check, if any): if it fails nothing is merged and the ticket stays for you to see
does.pullRequest: Push the branch and open a PR ({commits} commits): it closes as done once the PR is merged
does.cancelLeaves: {helper} leaves; a branch with commits is kept
does.drop: {n} closes as canceled: it was never sent
does.reject: #{n} goes back: {findings} points for {helper} to fix in another round
does.resolve: Have {helper} merge main into its branch, resolve the conflict, and hand it back
does.cure: Have {helper} fix it and hand it back
does.cleanWorktree: Clear its worktree and its branch with no commits; with changes left it is not deleted
does.reopen: {n} reopens: a new helper of the same profile carries on
does.conflicts: Merging into {base} would conflict ({files}): nothing is merged, the conflict is marked, and the ticket stays for you to see
does.merge: Merge into {base} ({commits} commits), close as done, and {helper} leaves

brief.handedOver: This ticket is handed over to you; {name} ({id}) was on it before
brief.reopened: This ticket is reopened; {name} ({id}) did it last time
brief.previous: This branch already has last time's commits; carry on from them.
brief.end: First look at the project as it is now, then carry on.
brief.failedHead: The acceptance failed; these need fixing:
brief.failedEnd: Once fixed, say how each was fixed in your conclusion.
brief.resume: The last round stopped halfway; carry on and finish it.
brief.cure: Fix it: {brief}. Look at the errors, fix them, and run the tests again
brief.cureTail: . Look at the errors, fix them, and run the tests again
brief.answerUnread: Fix it: the answer handed back last round could not be read ({problem}). Find it out, and hand it back in this format at the end:

move.inGraph: This ticket belongs to a plan and follows it: change it in the plan
move.byHelpers: In progress and For you to see come from a helper's work: move it to To do and it starts
move.drafting: {name} is drafting it: start it once the draft comes back
move.working: This round is still going: wait for it to come back, or move it to Canceled
move.failed: This round failed: send it for another round with a few words, or close it
move.reopen: Moving a closed ticket back to To do reopens it with a few words
move.revive: A ticket canceled before it started goes back to Backlog first
move.roundWithText: {say}: {command}, with --json status "{to}" and the text of what to do this round

timeline.told: You told it something; another round
timeline.cron: {missed, select, true {Started on schedule (made up)} other {Started on schedule}}
timeline.runtime: The machine carried on by itself

refinement.noDrafter: No helper can be sent to draft it
refinement.orchestrator: This ticket is the manager's: the manager reads it itself
refinement.onlyBacklog: Only a ticket in Backlog can be drafted: move it back to Backlog first
refinement.drafting: {name} is drafting it: wait for it to come back
refinement.noProject: No project was named: pick a project first
refinement.unread: The draft {name} handed back could not be read ({problem}); the ticket is unchanged: draft it again
refinement.unfinished: {name} did not finish the draft ({summary}); the ticket is unchanged: draft it again
refinement.noBlock: No draft found: it goes in a json code block
refinement.lines: {field}: must be a string or an array of strings
